title: Glossary
lead: Abbreviations (3GPP, AO, CBRA) and formula symbols ($p_{\mathrm{in}}$, $E_{\mathrm{up}}$). Not figure numbers.

g3gpp.body: The standards body behind 5G/NR and the Ambient IoT inventory study this simulator follows.
g3gpp.effect: Paper procedures (paging, CBRA, EM/DCM) are 3GPP Ambient IoT concepts, not a proprietary MAC.

aiot.body: Batteryless tags that harvest RF energy and do inventory with a reader/BS.
aiot.effect: Energy, not only collisions, sets T99.

bs.body: The 33 dBm CW transmitter and paging/CBRA counterpart.
bs.effect: Floor $(x,y)$ is visualization only; it does not compute $p_{\mathrm{in}}$.

cw.body: The reader’s always-on RF field that devices harvest.
cw.effect: Harvest power $P_{\mathrm{eh}}$ comes from $p_{\mathrm{in}}$ and $\xi$, not from a packet radio model.

wur.body: Low-power “doorbell” receiver. Useful for Device 2. Not used for Device 1 paper curves.
wur.effect: Shown in Device internals for structure.

ic.body: The radio that does paging listen and Msg1–3.

rf.body: The incident field $p_{\mathrm{in}}$ and the harvest/transmit radio.
rf.effect: All energy numbers start from RF incident power.

prach.body: Msg1 is the Ambient IoT random-access uplink, 0.5 ms on Device 1.
prach.effect: A 1 ms energy trace would skip entire Msg1 slots; this sim uses 0.5 ms dt.

cdf.body: Digitized indoor incident-power distribution. Hash is shown in CBRA meta.

rx.body: ON listening at $P_{\mathrm{rx}}$, or Msg2 reception.
rx.effect: ON windows drain energy even with no Msg1.

off.effect: Cannot hear paging or send Msg1.

on.effect: Eligible for paging if not DONE and above $E_{\mathrm{low}}$.

done.effect: Completion time feeds the inventoried-fraction plot.

nj.effect: Device 1 storage is hundreds of nJ; a CBRA costs a few nJ.

nw.body: Harvest $P_{\mathrm{eh}}$ is shown in nW (often ≪ 1 μW for weak tags).

dbm.effect: CDF clip in the inspector hint is −36 dBm.

ms.effect: dt = 0.5 ms; paging = 1 ms; Msg1/2 = 0.5 ms; Msg3 = 3 ms.

tpag.body: Length of one paging transmission. Paper: 1 ms.
tpag.effect: Hearing paging costs ON energy for that interval (and the rest of the ON window).

nao.body: $4\times 2=8$ AOs. A device picks one at random for Msg1.
nao.effect: Two Msg1 on the same AO is a collision.

ng.body: 1-group: $N_g=1$. 4-group: $N_g=4$. Default $g=\mathrm{id}\bmod N_g$ is a reproduction assumption.
ng.effect: Sets who is eligible on each paging index.

dt.body: Internal slot length. Energy History on-demand traces use this dt (not 1 ms).
dt.effect: Msg1 and Msg2 are 0.5 ms; coarser traces can skip them.
